subject: Request: SI partner promotional credits for onboarding push
messages:
From: Priya Narayanan <priya@si-partners.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Annie Brown <annie@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SI onboarding promo credits - 10 customer trials?

Hi Soojin,

Hope you had a great weekend — we discussed this with our enablement and sales ops folks and there s a chance to include Redwood credits as part of a co-sell onboarding package for 8-10 early-stage customers we re bringing through the accelerator. Annie from the marketplace looped in to confirm process if credits need to be issued via AWS Marketplace or direct Redwood promo codes.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide $25k worth of promo credits (or equivalent trial extensions) that our team can allocate across those accounts over the next 90 days? We re happy to fill out any intake form. Attaching the intake summary and proposed allocation.

Attachments: si_credit_request_form.pdf (filled), partner_term_sheet.docx (draft)

Thanks — Priya
Priya Narayanan
Head of Partnerships, SI Partners LLC
priya@si-partners.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Narayanan <priya@si-partners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Annie Brown <annie@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI onboarding promo credits - 10 customer trials?

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and for sending the intake. This sounds like a reasonable partner-led promotion for the accelerator cohort. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I loop in finance and ops:

- Is the $25k total a hard cap or a target (happy to approve if it s a target and you want flexible allocation)?
- Do you need the credits issued as AWS Marketplace entitlements (so they appear on the Marketplace listing) or as Redwood promo codes assigned to specific account emails?
- Can you confirm the expected timeline for each customer (onboarding start window) so we can set expiry dates appropriately?

I ll start an internal approval thread — copying Marissa for budget sign-off and Sergio for marketplace technical ops. If we approve, we ll provide the credits and a short FAQ that your team can share.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SI onboarding promo credits - approval request

Marissa / Sergio — forwarding a partner request: SI Partners are asking for $25k in promotional credits (target) to allocate across ~8-10 accelerator customers over 90 days. They re flexible on issuance method (Marketplace entitlements vs Redwood promo codes).

Summary of why: SI Partners will co-sell the cohort and commit to 10 enablement sessions and joint logos in the accelerator marketing. Expected 6 warm leads (likely to convert to paying within 3 months).

Attachments: si_credit_request_form.pdf, partner_term_sheet.docx

Can you advise:
- Budget OK for $25k partner-sourced credits?
- If approved, preference on issuance (marketplace entitlements vs direct codes)?

If it helps, I can reduce to $15k and reserve the remainder for future campaigns.

Thanks,
Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SI onboarding promo credits - approval request

Thanks for the context. Approve up to $20k from the partner promo pool for this program. A few conditions:

- Limit individual account allotment to $3k max to avoid overconcentration.
- Credits must expire 90 days from activation.
- Preference: issue as Redwood promo codes tied to emails (simpler tracking for our attribution), but we can support Marketplace entitlements if SI Partners insist — ops, please confirm technical overhead.

Sergio: can you confirm whether our Marketplace team needs extra lead time for entitlements? If entitlements add >5 business days of lead time, we'll default to promo codes.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Narayanan <priya@si-partners.com>, Annie Brown <annie@cloudmarketplace.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SI onboarding promo credits - issuance and next steps

Hi all — quick ops update. Marketplace entitlements route requires a request through AWS and typically takes ~7 business days to appear, plus verification. For this accelerator timeline that s tight. Recommendation: issue Redwood promo codes (we can generate 10 single-use codes now) and also submit the AWS entitlement request in parallel for record-keeping.

Next steps I ll take care of:
- Generate 10 single-use Redwood promo codes totaling $20,000 (per Marissa s approval) with 90-day expiry.
- Upload the allocation spreadsheet to the partner folder and share DocuSign-ready term sheet for signatures. Link: https://redwood-my.sharepoint.com/:w:/g/promotion-plan-draft
- HubSpot: I ll create a linked deal (RDW-ACCT-2026-1782) and tag the 10 accounts for attribution.

Priya / Annie: please confirm the 10 recipient emails (or we can create placeholder codes assigned to SI for distribution). Once I have recipient emails I ll issue codes and share the CSV.

Attachments: aws_marketplace_request_link.txt

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
